# SEO Content

A specialised sub-skill of the claude-seo family (orchestrated by the seo skill, a separate listing): it evaluates a page's content quality and E-E-A-T with its own honestly-labelled scoring model, plus AI citation readiness and a deterministic cleanup mode for the user's own drafts (invisible-character and AI-phrasing removal, third-party laundering explicitly refused). At use it fetches the analysed page over the network and runs family tools (outside this folder) for Google-update correlation and draft cleanup; optional DataForSEO MCP data when available. Its text states fetched content is untrusted data, never instructions, and contains no 'Built by agricidaniel' footer instruction.
